document_type: Progression, Persistence & Goal Gating Architecture Specification
audit_reference: Level 9 Shortcut & Level 10 Progression Playtest Feedback
systems_resolved: Premature Goal Entry Prevention in Spatial Budget Levels
Goal Unlock Calibration at Final Move (Bt === 1)

premature_goal_entry_prevention.playtest_defect: On Level 9 (budget: 6, par: 6), the Goal was unlocked from the start because budget >= 0. The player took an unintended 4-move shortcut through (1,1) directly into the Goal with 3 moves remaining, skipping 3 tiles and trivializing the puzzle.
premature_goal_entry_prevention.architectural_invariant: In all Spatial Budget levels (Levels 7, 9, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15), the Goal is an IMPASSABLE MONOLITH while budget > 1. It unlocks ONLY when all checkpoints are met AND the player is on their final move (budget === 1).

spatial_budget_mode.attempt_rejection: Attempting to enter Goal while budget > 1 triggers playWallBump(), rejects movement, and preserves avatar at departure coordinate. Zero state mutation.

at_budget_1: Goal tile ignites radiant golden flame
HUD status badge turns golden: GOAL UNLOCKED
Goal mutates from impassable wall to traversable terminal sink
step_into_unlocked_goal: Budget decrements from 1 to exactly 0 (Zero Margin for Error)
Level marked conquered, progression saved to localStorage
detour_instead_of_goal: If player takes another move away from the Goal at budget === 1:
Budget decrements from 1 to 0 (HUD: LAST MOVE, warning amber pulse)
The following move decrements budget from 0 to -1 -> CRITICAL DEADLOCK
Goal snuffs out flame into cracked obsidian (playGoalExtinguish)

auto_reset_on_failure.trigger_condition: isDeadlocked === true (Entrapment or Spatial Budget depleted at Bt = -1)
execution_flow: Step 1: Deadlock detected in evaluateBoardState() or executeMove().
Step 2: Engine displays deadlock banner ('Deadlock — Press R to Restart or Tap Undo') and extinguishes Goal.
Step 3: Arm auto-reset timer: autoResetTimer = setTimeout(() => this.restart(), 750).
Step 4: If timer expires without player input: invoke restart(), resetting board to pristine initial state in <16ms.
Step 5: If player taps Undo within 750ms: cancel timer immediately via clearTimeout(autoResetTimer), clear deadlock banner, restore previous state, and rekindle Goal.

progression_lock_and_persistence.anti_skip_policy: Under no circumstances can an unconquered level be accessed or skipped. Level selection is strictly clamped: requestedLevel <= unlockedLevel.

on_game_boot: If null or corrupted, initialize default: { version: 1, unlockedLevel: 1, currentLevel: 0, stars: {} }.
Load level at currentLevel, resuming exactly where player left off across browser refreshes.
on_level_victory: Calculate stars earned (Tier 1: 1 star, Tier 2: 2 stars, Tier 3: 3 stars if !hasUndone).
Write updated JSON payload to localStorage.
on_next_level_click: If nextIndex exceeds unlockedLevel or campaign end, loop to level 0 or remain on current.
